cases.title: Route one stage at a time

expected_outcomes: Start broad routing at ddd-discover
Emit one stage request at a time in canonical order
Preserve evidence and state without emulating focused behavior

cases.title: Preserve an unchanged manual request

cases.title: Preserve a valid result into the next request

expected_outcomes: Consume the exact valid result

cases.title: Stop at the earliest missing prerequisite

expected_outcomes: Return a bounded stop naming missing scope and evidence

simple CRUD and low change risk

expected_outcomes: Mark tactical and adoption artifacts stale
Route to ddd-strategic as the earliest invalidated stage

cases.title: Stop on an incomplete stage result
